answer_1.quote: Diacritic restoration (or diacritization) is the process of restoring these missing diacritics for every character in the written texts.
answer_1.outputs: Diacritic restoration outputs for Arabic text

answer_2.quote: For diacritic restoration, the two most typically used metrics are Word Error Rate (WER) and Diacritic Error Rate (DER), the percentages of incorrectly diacritized words and characters, respectively.
